::: {.obsidian-onboarding-checklist}
:::

State the purpose of the checklist in one paragraph. Name who owns
each step.

# Before the start date

- Send the contract and the offer pack.
- Request right to work documents.
- Order the laptop and the phone.
- Create the accounts and the badge.
- Book the desk and the induction.

# First day

- Welcome the starter and tour the office.
- Introduce the team.
- Run the security and data protection induction.
- Set up the accounts and the phone.

# First week

- Run the role induction.
- Book the mandatory training.
- Assign the first task.
- Schedule the first review.

# First month

- Hold the first performance review.
- Confirm the probation arrangements.
- Collect feedback on the onboarding process.
